title: Gold & silver price chart
description: Compare 24K, 22K, 18K, 14K, and 9K gold with silver — daily rates from our database, updated throughout the day.
chartSubtitle: Daily closing rate per IST calendar day

insights.gold24Up: 24K gold rose over the selected period — selling old gold may be favourable.
insights.gold24Down: 24K gold eased — could be a better window for new 24K purchases.
insights.gold24Flat: 24K held steady with limited daily movement.
insights.gold22Up: 22K (jewellery purity) moved higher — making charges still apply on finished pieces.
insights.gold22Down: 22K softened — compare quotes before commissioning custom work.
insights.gold22Flat: 22K tracked sideways — predictable budgeting for schemes.
insights.silverUp: Silver (1 kg) gained — factor into silver article pricing.
insights.silverDown: Silver eased — useful for bulk or gifting orders.
insights.silverFlat: Silver stayed in a narrow band.
insights.spread: 22K trades below 24K by roughly the karat ratio — both charts help you spot divergence.
insights.volatile: Wider daily swings than usual — lock a quote on heavier orders.
insights.stable: Rates moved in a tight range — good clarity for planning.
